narrative:
Hardin County has 17,357 registered voters, with 13.6% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 35.4% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 48.0%, a pronounced Democratic lean of 12.6 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 27.6% of registrants.
